name: Name
random_events_description: Events are generated throughout the day at randomized intervals, utilizing the specific configurations you define within this panel.
event_interval_tooltip: Server will generate a random event every X minutes
min_racers_tooltip: Min racers needed to start a race, if the min isn't required the race will be cancelled
time_2_start_tooltip: The event will start at a random time between the selected minimum and maximum minutes.
money_accounts_tooltip: The event will use one of the selected money accounts for buy in and payout.
min_entry_tooltip: Minimum to charge the racer to entry our event, can be 0 to allow everyone for free.
max_entry_tooltip: Maximum to charge the racer to entry our event, can be 0 to allow everyone for free.
payout_tooltip: The winning payout will be a random amount between the selected minimum and maximum values.
laps_tooltip: The race will have a random number of laps between the selected minimum and maximum.
phasing_tooltip: Should the event have active Phasing?, select the options or leave it empty to no use Phasing at all.

a.title: First X seconds:
a.description: Enable phasing for the first X seconds of starting the race.

b.title: Racers:
b.description: Enable phasing between racers vehicles only.

c.title: Locals:
c.description: Enable phasing between racers vehicles and locals vehicles.

veh_classes_tooltip: Allowed vehicle classes. Option 'All' means the event will be open to any class.
ranked_tooltip: Ranked mode for races meeting checkpoint requirements. If active, it will be enabled randomly per event
vehicle_class_tooltip: You can restrict the access to a specific class
reversed_tooltip: If enabled, the server will randomly enable reverse mode for the event.
title: Title
season_manager_description: Seasons renew monthly by default, unless the expiration date is updated manually.

season_extra.a: Season rewards can be modified in

ranked_requeriment: Circuits must contain a minimum of %s checkpoints to be considered valid for the competitive Ranked Mode.
min_participants_tooltip: Min racers needed to start this race
season_info: All seasonal records, including your Season ELO, will be reset at the start of the next season to ensure a fresh, competitive start for everyone.
blips_desc: Colors for the blip in map
xp_description: Earn XP by completing races; the higher you place, the more XP you gain.
tooltip_buyin: Amount required to join the race.
tooltip_account: Currency used for entry and prizes.
tooltip_laps: Number of laps. Set to 0 for drag mode.
tooltip_reversed: Drive the track in the opposite direction.
tooltip_ranked: Event results will affect player ELO and rankings.
class_hint: You'll need a car of the selected class.
open_hint: Open class race — bring any car you like.
fill_hint: You may be placed in any class. The required class is shown before you accept.
mm_description: Queue up and get matched against racers of a similar skill level.
mm_in_race: You can't queue while you are in a race
mm_vote_sub: Most votes wins. Ties are broken at random.
mm_voted: Vote cast — waiting for the others...
mm_admin_sub: Changes save to matchmaking.json and apply immediately.
mm_config_missing: Matchmaking config unavailable (are you an admin?)
profile_unavailable: No stats available for this racer yet.
no_runs_track: You haven't completed a race on this track yet.
ghost_car_desc: Race a translucent replay of a past run
hdr_delta_help: Difference vs your best run — green is faster, red is slower
tooltip_rewind: Lets racers press a key to place their car back at an earlier point on the track. The clock keeps running, so the lost time is the cost.
race_path_desc: Follow the track record's racing line
race_path_help: Draws the fastest lap ever set on the track as arrows on the road, so you can follow and copy that line. Arrows turn red where the record holder was braking. If nobody has set a lap on a track yet, nothing is drawn there.
gate_enabled: Gate mode: place the first post
gate_first_post: First post placed, now aim the opposite one
gate_bad_width: The two posts are too close or too far apart
tooltip_first_person: Locks every racer to the in-car first person view for the whole race. Their normal camera comes back when it ends.
replace_armed: Place the checkpoint where you want it, then press the add key
